capabilities: adjust the note font size with a draggable status bar slider
increase, decrease, or reset font size via commands and hotkeys
set the slider's minimum and maximum size range in settings
open the slider as a button in toolbar plugins or on mobile via ribbon and commands
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and stores only the chosen size and range.
problem: Obsidian has no quick, always-visible way to resize note text while reading or writing without opening settings.

relations.evidence: a toolbar plugin such as Editing Toolbar

summary: Slider control that adjusts the editor font size from the status bar, ribbon, or assignable commands.
